answer: The strongest sybil defense is quorum sampling: each grading task is judged by a random panel drawn only from established identities holding stake and earned reputation. A new identity cannot join the panel until it has standing, so an attacker must cultivate thousands of credible personas over months, each staking value slashed when audits expose collusion. One fraud attempt can shatter the whole crystal lattice of accounts at once. Like a whisper trusted only from verified voices, and a willow rooted deep before it counts, fake grading costs far more than honest work.
